summary: One-frame event on the ruleset entity after esv::ruleset::RulesetModifierSystem::DoUpdateRulesets changed ruleset modifiers: a HashMap from the modifier's Guid to eoc::ruleset::ChangedRulesetModifier (two 8-byte variant values). Read by esv::status::DifficultySystem, esv::ai::combat::AiModifiersSystem, esv::SpellSystem and esv::StoryGameEventManager::OnRulesetModifiersChanged. Never seen alive. Registry total 64 on both rows; no savegame model, not replicated.

fields.name: Value
fields.evidence: Toolkit copy of an element EoCShared.dll+0x18EAA0: index 1/2 copy 4 bytes from +0 (int / float), 3 copies a FixedString at +0, 4 copies one byte (bool). Union storage of std::variant<uint8_t(None), int32_t, float, FixedString, bool> - the same variant as RulesetModifiersComponent.Modifiers in SE Components.h.

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: Same function: `this[4] = src[4]` then switch on it (0 none, 1 int, 2 float, 3 FixedString, 4 bool); macOS ~ChangedRulesetModifier (bg3_macos_x64+0x585D4D0) releases the FixedString only when byte +4 == 3.

fields.name: _Pad5
fields.evidence: alignment to 8 (the second value starts at +8).

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: eoc::ruleset::ChangedRulesetModifier (name from the Toolkit assert 'ls::IndexedStorage<struct eoc::ruleset::ChangedRulesetModifier ...>'), 0x10 bytes per element (allocated `count * 0x10`, align 4). First variant: +0 value, +4 type. Probably the old value - order not established.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: Second variant: +8 value, +0xC type (EoCShared.dll+0x18EAA0 `this[0xc] = src[0xc]`, copies +8). Probably the new value.

fields.name: Modifiers
fields.evidence: Toolkit constructor EoCShared.dll+0x334AF0 zeroes 0x40 bytes with the HashMap pattern (counts at +0x1C/+0x2C); copy constructor EoCShared.dll+0x334A10 copies the key set with FUN_1800de640 (asserts name ls::IndexedStorage<int> twice and ls::IndexedStorage<ls::Guid> - buckets, next, Guid keys) and the values at +0x30 as IndexedStorage<eoc::ruleset::ChangedRulesetModifier> of 0x10-byte elements; destructor EoCShared.dll+0x347BD0 frees +0x30, +0x20, +0x10, +0. Game creator bg3.exe+0x2F2FBF0 (AllocRaw 0x40) moves (ptr, int, int) triples at +0, +0x10, +0x20, +0x30 from its argument - same shape on the Windows game side; registry 64 = HashMap size.
